content: अभ्यस्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Repeated, frequently practised, exercised; नयनयोरभ्यस्तमामीलनम् <ls>Amaru. 97</ls>; used or accustomed to; अनभ्यस्तरथचर्याः <ls>U. 5</ls>; not accustomed to the use of the chariot; ˚गुणा च वाणी <ls>Māl. 3. 11</ls>. .²2 Learnt, studied; शैशवेऽभ्यस्तविद्यानाम् <ls>R. 1. 8</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 89</ls>. .²3 (In <ab>Math.</ab>) Multiplied; अयुतं दशकृत्वोऽभ्यस्तं नियुतमुच्यते <ls>Nir.</ls> .²4 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Reduplicated. .{@-स्तम्@} Reduplicated base of a root.

अभ्यस्तम् {%ind.%} .²1 [अस्तमभि] Towards sunset; ˚गम् -इ, -या to go down or set (as the sun) during or with reference to some act. .²2 Repeated, again and again; अभ्यस्तं भौतिकं पश्यन् <ls>Mb. 12. 278. 16</ls>.
